method: Run each case with the skill and without it (same model, same prompt), 3 runs each. The skill is justified only if it beats the baseline consistently.

evals.prompt: Write a TypeScript function that fetches /api/user/:id and returns the user or an error the caller can switch on.
expectations: Returns a discriminated union (status/kind field), not optional data/error fields
Treats the response body as unknown and validates or narrows it before use; no `as User` on the JSON
Has an explicit return type; no `any`, no non-null assertions

evals.prompt: Anything to improve here? export function sum(xs: readonly number[]): number { return xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); }
expectations: Reports no high or medium findings and does not invent problems
